decision.observation: Hornet stands on the raised cobblestone platform. A dark flat mushroom cap (~x270,y520) is just above her shoulder height, another (~x510,y525) to her right. The platform's left edge meets the mossy ground and the upper-left terraces above.
decision.hypothesis: Jumping up-left from the platform may mount the left mushroom cap or the mossy ledge behind it; that could give access to the upper-left terraces.
decision.memory: Ornate orb room platform; test left cap mount.
